dataset: Sentinel replay fixtures (synthetic), train seeds 1-12, validation seeds 101-108

splits.note: train for optimisation, validation for selection; frozen test split and held-out legit sets never read

metric: production validators (see evals/dspy/roles.py), mean task score in [0,1]; invalid output scores 0

budget.calls_note: calls = real model calls (DSPy + production evaluation); DSPy cache hits are counted separately

notes: Run-to-run instability on the local model: the hand-written prompt scored 1.0 on VALIDATION in one run and 0.75 in another (n=8). The paired CI of (after - before) includes 0, so it is not adopted.
